name: Antonius of Argos
bio: Antonius of Argos is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no firm date for the poet. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Wreath of Philippus, the Garland compiled in the first century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 102).

poems.title: Book IX, 102: On the Same
poems.author: Antonius of Argos
poems.text: I, once the stronghold of sky-mounting Perseus, I, the nurse of the star! so cruel to the sons of Ilium, am left deserted now to be a fold for the goat-herds of the wilderness, and at length the spirit of Priam is avenged on me.
